title: fetch_reference_rates request
description: One JSON object that names a base currency and, if you want only some rates, the currencies to return. The tool reads https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml. A currency that the European Central Bank did not publish on the reference date is refused with the code currency_not_published after the read.

base.description: Three-letter currency code in capital letters, for example EUR or USD. The rates are units of each symbol for one unit of this currency.

symbols.description: The currencies to return, 1 to 40 codes without repeats. Leave the field out to get every published currency except the base.
